QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] Destructive Tendencies
QuestInfo.0: Azwan's king, Iason, is not replying. Talk with Medina the Shamaness to see if you can find out why.
QuestInfo.1: According to Medina, Hilla used to be a high female shaman who was respected and loved by the people of Azwan. However, she turned on them all and gave them to the Black Mage as a present. Go see the aftermath of her treachery in Azwan.\n\n#rTip: Participate in Fight for Azwan.
QuestInfo.2: Hilla's army... is the entire city of Azwan!

0.0: I apologize, outsider. His highness is rather stubborn about new people stepping foot on his land, after the whole... Hilla incident.
0.1: Your aura is quite positive. Azwan was once full of people like me, women able to direct the flow of energy from one person to another. Our title was #bShamaness#k. Hilla... was one of us.
0.2: Among the shamanesses, Lady Hill... no, Hilla was the most beautiful, the most skilled in song and dance. She was a charismatic leader with phenomenal abilities. We all looked upon her in adoration... #runtil she presented Azwan to the Black Mage as a gift#k.
0.3: Thousands of people, all taken body and soul by a selfish woman to appease her fool of a master. It's hard to even think of this pile of rubble as the Azwan I once knew.
0.4: I think a visit around the city will give you more perspective. Take the #bportal on the right#k to look around Azwan. Observe what became of us. Witness the cruelty done by Hilla. Once you see it with your own eyes, you will understand our rage.

yes.0: That portal was created so that his highness and other officials could quickly travel across Azwan. Taking it should help you get around the #rbattlefield#k without being spotted.

no.0: Was the respect and love of her people not enough?

1.0: Have you seen the devastation? Those monsters were once good people. Only those of us who were directly beneath the Holy Obelisk escaped with our minds. The rest...
1.1: It is too much to bear. Our sanity and our minds may remain, but we have no hope of stopping Hilla. We need a warrior like yourself to aid us. Please, I beg you!
